item.title: Trust Wallet Adds bStocks to Put Tokenized Nvidia and Tesla Inside a Self-Custody Wallet
item.content:encoded:
Trust Wallet now supports bStocks, tokenized US securities issued on BNB Chain, accessible directly from the wallet with no traditional brokerage account.
Five assets are live at launch: NVDAB (Nvidia), TSLAB (Tesla), CRCLB (Circle Internet Group), MUB (Micron Technology), and SNDKB (SanDisk Corporation), swappable with USDT.
Holders receive economic exposure to price movements, dividends, and stock splits, processed automatically. bStocks are certificates under ADGM rules, not direct share ownership.
From day one, bStocks plug into BNB Chain DeFi: lending on Venus and Lista DAO, trading on PancakeSwap and Aster, while dividends continue to accrue.
The launch lands as tokenized stocks grow from $2 million to $1.4 billion in onchain value in under a year, with the SEC, Nasdaq, and DTCC all moving on the category.
bStocks are not available in the United States, the United Kingdom, or the European Union, and access is limited to eligible users in permitted jurisdictions.

item.title: Rethinking Design by Contract for the Age of Stateless AI Agents
item.content:encoded: This article revisits Bertrand Meyer's Design by Contract framework through the lens of AI-assisted software development. The piece proposes that contracts must evolve from correctness specifications into self-contained reconstructions of system intent, capable of serving as the working memory for future agent interactions.

item.title: Building a Fake Solar Plant for Cybersecurity Research — Part 2
item.content:encoded: A contained honeypot impersonating a small internet-facing energy site collected 54 days of traffic – roughly 1.7 million events from 16,568 unique sources, discovered within the first hour. Most was commodity automation, but a thin tail spoke real Modbus, including 392 device-identity reads with zero write or control attempts. On ATT&CK for ICS the industrial activity maps to discovery and never reaches impact, while the SSH chain still completed: weak logins led to commodity DDoS, proxy, and backdoor malware.

item.title: The AI Independence Movement: Why the Next Generation of Intelligence Must Be Decentralized
item.content:encoded:
Artificial intelligence today is controlled by a small number of centralized providers that dominate compute, storage, and inference. This creates risks like vendor lock-in, rising costs, and lack of transparency.
This article explores a decentralized AI future where GPU networks, open inference systems, and permanent storage replace centralized control. In this model, AI becomes more transparent, resilient, and user-owned.
It also proposes a practical architecture for building decentralized AI systems and outlines how developers can contribute using distributed compute networks like GPU marketplaces.
The goal is simple: shift AI from centralized ownership to an open, verifiable, and globally accessible infrastructure layer.

item.title: BTCC Exchange Celebrates 15 Years: Built for The Long Game
item.content:encoded:
Lodz, Poland, June 11th, 2026/Chainwire/--BTCC, the world's longest-serving cryptocurrency exchange, is celebrating its 15th anniversary under the theme "Built for the Long Game". Founded in 2011, BTCC has navigated every major crypto market cycle while continuing to serve traders worldwide with secure and professional trading services.

In the cryptocurrency world, fifteen years tells a story that very few platforms ever get to tell. For BTCC, this milestone is not a moment to look back, but a starting point for what comes next: expanding what traders can access, how they trade, and what a platform with this track record can make possible.

The anniversary also marks a meaningful step in BTCC's global brand journey. The exchange has become an official regional partner of the Argentine Football Association, bringing together two names built for champions and defined by resilience and long-term excellence. Argentina's national team, the reigning FIFA World Cup and Copa América champions, carries a legacy built over generations. This spirit reflects BTCC's own path through the highs and lows of the crypto industry.

To celebrate the milestone with its global community, BTCC is launching a World Cup Showdown campaign with a prize pool of over $1.5 million.

From Crypto to Multi-Asset

For an exchange that has weathered fifteen years of market cycles, playing the long game means recognising when the game itself is changing. Global trading markets are converging, and that shift is exactly what BTCC has been building toward. The exchange now offers tokenized perpetual futures and a dedicated TradFi section covering stocks, metals, indices, forex, and commodities. To lower the barriers further, BTCC is also cutting perpetual futures trading fees and introducing zero-fee trading on TradFi futures. 

Looking ahead, BTCC will continue expanding into traditional financial trading, not to chase short-term trends, but to build a richer, more engaging trading environment that keeps pace with how traders' needs are evolving.

Stronger Infrastructure, Deeper Liquidity

The long game requires more than the right products. It requires the infrastructure to support them. BTCC is planning a fully rebuilt trading system scheduled for launch by the end of 2026, with the aim of delivering even faster order response times, improved matching efficiency, and stronger risk management under volatile conditions. It will also serve as the technical foundation for future multi-asset products.

At the same time, AI is being integrated across internal operations, covering risk identification, user support, market monitoring, and data analysis. By building smarter workflows internally first, BTCC is laying the groundwork to bring these capabilities to users over time.

Built for the Long Game

Fifteen years is a long time in an industry that has seen countless platforms come and go. While others chase the trends, BTCC keeps asking a harder question: what does a trader actually need to be here for the long haul? BTCC has remained standing through every major market cycle by staying focused on what traders actually need: security, stability, and access to the markets that matter. 

As the exchange enters its next chapter, that same focus is driving a broader product lineup, lower trading costs, stronger infrastructure, and deeper liquidity. For BTCC, the long game does not end at fifteen. It is just getting started.

#BTCC15 | #BTCCxArgentineFA | #BuiltForChampions

About BTCC

Founded in 2011, BTCC is a leading global cryptocurrency exchange serving over 11 million users across 100+ countries. As the official regional sponsor of the Argentine Football Association (AFA) and with NBA All-Star Jaren Jackson Jr. as its global brand ambassador, BTCC offers secure and accessible cryptocurrency trading services, focused on delivering a user-friendly experience while adhering to applicable regulatory standards.
